# UX & Lifecycle Requirements-Quality Checklist: Notes & Pinboard Lifecycle

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the written requirements of Package 2.3 (notes pinboard UX, lifecycle, conversion, Note Assistant) — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage.
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist` (depth: standard, audience: PR reviewer, focus: lifecycle/UX + grounding/quota risk). Checkbox state belongs to the reviewer.
**Review Ownership**: Mark an item `[x]` only when the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the Note Editor's entry, focus, and close behaviors all specified (create, open, close, return to list)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, FR-NM-01]
- [x] CHK002 Are the formatting capabilities (headings, bold, italic, bulleted/numbered lists, links) enumerated and tied to a persistence format? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Is the definition of "displayed order" for multi-note concatenation specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how a note title longer than the source title limit is handled on single-note conversion? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, SourceTitle 1–100]
- [x] CHK005 Are the progress/status states for conversion as a separate phase from synthesis specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK006 Is the toast/label text for Save to note, disabled conversion, and the comparison-source prompt stated exactly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, FR-012, FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "within one second after a typing pause" defined with a debounce interval and an overall deadline? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, SC-001]
- [x] CHK008 Is "citation badges removed from editable prose" precise enough to know which tokens are removed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK009 Is "pending or error status" for offline editing defined with distinct, named states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK010 Is "distinguishes note assertions from other source facts" quantified or given an observable output marker? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the title limit (200 code points), source title limit (100), and "retains its title" statements agree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 Do read-only saved responses (FR-NM-02) and "Convert to source without editing" (Gate scenario) agree on which operations are allowed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, US3]
- [x] CHK013 Are Owner-only v2.0 permissions consistent with the card's Owner/Editor/Viewer wording? [Consistency, Spec §Role Phasing]
- [x] CHK014 Does the shared save-note action in Package 2.2 use the same input, idempotency key, and output as FR-NM-02? [Consistency, Plan §Shared save-note contract]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Can every Gherkin scenario (create/auto-save, survive clear chat, Gate round trip, multi-note, critique, summarize) be mapped to an objective pass/fail test? [Measurability, Spec §US1–US4]
- [x] CHK016 Are the timing criteria (≤300 ms, ≤2.0 s, ≤2.5 s TTFT) tied to a defined fixture or measurement start/stop? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, SC-003, FR-019]
- [x] CHK017 Is the "zero deselected-source leakage" criterion for the round trip linked to NFR-EVAL-04 with an observable boundary? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are exact-boundary cases defined for title (1/200/201), body (100,000/100,001 words), assistant selection (1/50/51), source bytes and words? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Is the empty/whitespace-only combined body case defined, including what counts as "body" versus titles? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for a note deleted, edited, or revisioned while a conversion or assistant action is in flight? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK021 Is the abrupt-termination/offline recovery flow (draft retained, restored, never shown as saved) specified end to end? [Recovery, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK022 Are cross-notebook and invalid note IDs rejected with defined behavior and no source created? [Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Is behavior defined when "Convert all notes" runs on a notebook with more notes than the Note Assistant's 50-note cap? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, FR-014]

## Non-Functional & Security Requirements

- [x] CHK024 Are sanitization requirements for stored/rendered note content (script, HTML, unsafe link schemes) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK025 Are authorization rechecks before reading and before publishing specified for every assistant operation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, C-02]
- [x] CHK026 Is atomic slot reservation and slot release on failure stated for conversion, including concurrent attempts at 49/50 sources? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK027 Are accessibility requirements (keyboard operation of add/delete/convert, labelled selection checkboxes, status announcements) specified or explicitly deferred? [Gap, Accessibility]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 Are the dependencies on FR-WM-07 (quota), FR-SI-01 (Markdown ingestion), FR-GC-02/09 (citations/save), C-01 and C-02 documented with ownership? [Dependencies, Spec §Source Traceability]
- [x] CHK029 Is the assumption that note citations are provenance only (new answers cite the new source's chunks) stated unambiguously? [Assumption, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK030 Are out-of-scope items (live sync, collaborative editing, binary attachments, Studio reports) explicit? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions & Out of Scope]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK031 Is there any conflict between "preserve original notes" and note deletion cascading to converted sources (should deleting a note affect its source)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011, FR-NM-03]
- [x] CHK032 Is the model-call boundary clear: which steps are deterministic pipelines and which is the agentic synthesis? [Clarity, Plan §Execution Model]

- Items CHK003, CHK004, CHK011, CHK020, CHK023, CHK024, CHK027, CHK031 are the identified gaps; they are resolved in `/speckit-analyze` (spec/FR-card flow-back) and re-reviewed before implementation sign-off.
